items.prompt: On some days a clear acrylic panel of the same size was lowered into the pool instead of the mirror, because
items.evidence: In the first phase a large two-way mirror was lowered into one section of their pool on some days and, on other days, a transparent acrylic panel of identical size was used instead as a control, so that researchers could distinguish curiosity about a novel object from a specific response to a reflection.

Cozucu artik iki kontrol gerekcesi arasindan seffaf panelin hangisine hizmet ettigini secmek zorunda; eskiden bu cerceveye uyan tek son A idi. Sekiz sonun sekizi de ozne ve cekimli fiil tasiyan tam bir yan cumle; baslangictaki baglactan sonra hepsi dilbilgisi olarak isliyor, yani bicimden eleme yolu yine kapali. Degisen sey, artik her baslangic icin ayni cerceveye oturan en az bir rakip sonun bulunmasi: secim yalniz pasajdaki ayrintiyla yapilabiliyor.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the transparent panel of identical size was used as a control, so that curiosity about a novel object could be separated from a specific response to a reflection.
